description: This file defines support functionalities for pairing alerts in a macOS application, including UI presentation, state management, and request handling for pairing operations.

classes.name: PairingAlertHostWindow
classes.description: A custom NSWindow subclass that can become key and main window, used as a host for pairing alert sheets.

classes.name: PairingAlertState
classes.description: A class to hold the state of the current active alert, request ID, and the alert host window.

methods.name: endActiveAlert
methods.description: Ends the currently active NSAlert and clears the associated request ID.

methods.name: configureDefaultPairingAlert
methods.description: Configures an NSAlert with default buttons and styles for a pairing prompt.

methods.name: beginCenteredSheet
methods.description: Displays an NSAlert as a sheet centered on the host window.

methods.name: runPairingPushTask
methods.description: Runs a background task to refresh connection, load pending data, and handle push notifications.

methods.name: startPairingPushTask
methods.description: Starts a background task for push notifications if not already running.

methods.name: beginPairingAlert
methods.description: Creates and presents a pairing alert sheet on the host window.

methods.name: presentPairingAlert
methods.description: Displays a pairing alert with a given request ID, message, and handler.

methods.name: presentPairingAlert<Request>
methods.description: Displays a pairing alert and handles response for a specific request.

methods.name: clearActivePairingAlert
methods.description: Clears the current active alert and request ID, and hides the alert window.

methods.name: stopPairingPrompter
methods.description: Stops the pairing prompt process, cancels tasks, and clears related state.

methods.name: approveRequest
methods.description: Handles approval of a pairing request, executing an action and logging the result.

methods.name: rejectRequest
methods.description: Handles rejection of a pairing request, executing an action and logging the result.
